stem: Mercury pigment is classically removed with:
rationale: Iodine followed by sodium thiosulfate is the classic mercury-pigment removal sequence.

distractor_rationales.B: Acid alcohol and bluing are used in hematoxylin differentiation and bluing, not mercury-pigment removal.
distractor_rationales.C: Hydrogen peroxide may bleach some pigments but is not the classic mercury-removal sequence.
distractor_rationales.D: Xylene and paraffin are processing reagents and do not chemically remove mercury pigment.

learning_objective: Identify the classic reagent sequence used to remove mercury pigment.
